axis: The September 2026 aerial view aligns the three-arch masonry span with the eastern, hillside-side channel. The longer western bridge crosses the adjacent branch. A north-up aerial trace of the 23.03 m eastern deck gives the signed heading. +X follows the deck east by north toward the hillside. +Z faces south by east toward the older photograph. The rounded pier noses face north by west.
source: Standard Protomaps PMTiles with cross-check of Esri World Imagery and the September 2026 aerial photograph

mappedIdentity.distinction: The candidate QID locates the village. The mapped road geometry and photographs identify the bridge.
